display_long_description:
Dystopia is a free VR rhythm game: slice or shoot glowing crystals to the beat. With a blade in each hand, cut each crystal the way its arrow points. With a laser pistol, hit it from any angle.

# Live radio you slice or shoot
Five stations, always on. Every song is unique, made on the spot for its premiere. Everyone tuned to your station plays it at the same moment. Hear one you love? Save it to your Archive to replay it as it aired.

# Train your very own pet fruit fly to play like you
Your pet fruit fly learns your moves. The more you play, the more it learns. Slice or shoot it to swap places: it takes over while you take flight and explore the world.

# Discover your sound
- **MENTAL:** metal and rock where the riffs never die
- **PULSE:** EDM and club, the bass line is your heartbeat
- **DRIFT:** lo-fi and chill, your calm in the chaos
- **VOLT:** industrial synth and electronic, no off switch
- **WAVE:** pop and dance, catchy hooks all day

# Your world rises with your play
Play well and the world around you builds. Miss and it crumbles. The laser show rides the beat; every hit brings your next world closer.

**Easy to Insane:** five difficulties, from a first cruise to patterns that earn a real sweat.

**Station DJs:** every station has its own host with intros, reactions, banter, even the weather.

**Rare golden crystal:** hit it to step into another reality: Comic, Noir, and more.

Built for Meta Quest 3 and Meta Quest 3S.

Welcome to Dystopia. Slice responsibly.
